points.description: The answer conveys that slow start is the phase where cwnd grows rapidly, roughly doubling each RTT (by one segment per acknowledgement), until cwnd reaches ss_thresh or a loss occurs.
The answer conveys that congestion avoidance is the phase, entered once cwnd reaches ss_thresh, where cwnd grows slowly and roughly linearly (about one segment per RTT) rather than exponentially.
The answer conveys that when a packet loss (congestion) occurs, ss_thresh is set to half of cwnd and cwnd is reset to 1.

rubric.notes: Full mark (1) requires naming both phases and describing how cwnd grows in each (exponential/doubling in slow start, linear/slower in congestion avoidance) plus the loss response that sets ss_thresh to cwnd/2 and resets cwnd to 1. Equivalent wording and alternative linear-growth strategies earn the marks. Missing or wrong phase behaviour loses that point; examples and side remarks in the model answer are not separately required.
